QuestInfo.name: [Luna Crystal] Visit the Fairy House!
QuestInfo.0: Wisp wants to talk to you while you're on a walk with the Petite Fairy Pets. What can this be about?
QuestInfo.1:
Equip all 3 Petite Fairy Pets, then return to Wisp.
You must equip the #rPetite Luna pets born from the Luna Crystal#k before you go.

0.0: Hello, traveler!! Oh my! Who is that cute fairy next to you?\r\n
0.1: I've heard of beautiful children being born of the moonlight's energy, but I didn't think I would see one in person...!!\r\n
0.2: If it wasn't for you, #h0#, I wouldn't have ever gotten to see these children in real life! \r\nThey're such beautiful creatures...
0.3: This won't do. #h0#, if you bring all three creatures from the #e#bPetite Fairy Set#k#n, I'll give you a gift!! What do you say?\r\n\r\n#r(This event is a quest that can only be completed once per world.)
